theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_plane_closedBall_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ P = n → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → μHE[n] ((P : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.closedBall 0 s) = ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) * volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
